messages:
deploybot: tag created: v2.8.0-rc3
deploybot: repo: github.com/redwood-inference/serving
deploybot: commit: 9f3b2c7 (patch: perf fixes + canary routing tweak)
deploybot: environments: canary (EU-1 10%), staging. Not yet promoted to prod.
deploybot: changelog (high level):
- reduce KV-cache memory spikes during long-tail sequences
- improve batching heuristics for short prompts
- fix rare NPE in router when pool drains
- docs: update quantization guide

celeste: nice, can you paste the short changelog in the release notes section?
deploybot: release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/releases/tag/v2.8.0-rc3
jamal: QA: i'll run the onboarding prompts against canary in ~30m. watching latency for prefix cache warm-up.
qa-lina: flagged one small regression locally: first-request 502s when cache miss + long prompt. i can share logs after run.
ops-amy: noted. if it's reproducible we should hold prod pin. whats the planned change window?
celeste: change window today 21:00-23:00 UTC if we promote. otherwise will wait for next window.
karim: ops: canary traffic is already 10% EU. i've set extra logging for kv-cache warm-up.
release-manager: request: please pin prod manifest? we need explicit thumbs before promote.
celeste: @release-manager can we get a quick checklist: QA signoff, SRE watch, rollback plan confirmed.
sre-micah: rollback plan: revert tag + routing fallback to v2.7.x, autoscale policy unchanged. preflight: ensure 2 spare nodes in each region.
jamal: QA: initial runs look ok except the 502 spike Lina saw. attaching snippet:
```
[2024-06-05T19:32:10Z] request id=abc123 status=502 backend=kv-cache error=timeout
[2024-06-05T19:32:10Z] stack=serving/cache.go:214: timeout while populate
```
qa-lina: exact repro steps: send 8K token prompt with prefix that triggers cache miss. happens ~1/40.
ops-amy: can we mitigate by warming cache for the next rollout? maybe backfill frequent prefixes during canary.
karim: i can add a short-lived prewarm job to run before promoting. low-risk.
release-manager: ok checklist status: QA pending (Lina to confirm), SRE preflight ok (Micah), ops mitigation planned (Karim). no pin yet.
celeste: tagging: @release-manager @ops-amy @qa-lina please react with :thumbsup: when you're happy to pin and promote to prod window.
qa-lina: :thumbsup: once i finish the last run (10m).
jamal: noted, i'll keep monitoring.
sre-micah: :thumbsup: nodes checked and spare capacity ok.
ops-amy: :thumbsup: prewarm job ready, schedule on approval.
deploybot: status update: canary healthy (error rate 0.18% over 15m), latency p50=42ms, p95=320ms.
release-manager: holding for final QA signoff. will pin for promote once we have all :thumbsup:.
